headline: Going Commando USA v1.01 reaches 84.74% matched code
summary: USA v1.01 ends the day at 84.74% matched code by size and 7,760 of 8,579 functions. Matching means C that compiles to the original game’s bytes. The separate results quoted in #386 put USA v2.00 at 80.93% code and 7,586 of 8,634 functions, and Europe/Australia at 54.14% code and 6,992 of 8,672 functions; those are that pull request’s measurements, rather than the final USA v1.01 report.
highlights: #384 brings 453 boot and level functions into C. #386 adds release-specific matching, the lock-on tether family and compiler fixes; its 353,072 added lines dominate the day’s 500,097 additions.
#387 matches 13 functions in Yeedil and Aranos prison and repairs a prior function for PAL and USA v2.00. #385 matches trail and dust-puff routines among its three matches.
#388 matches `func_00292078` at all 28 USA v1.01 placements and fixes generation of release-specific demotions.
The native-port functional backfill remains a draft (#389). Its functional C adds no matched functions and is excluded from the matching build.
